sentences.en: Conclusion The early use of antiacid as an intervenient measure can reduce the gastrointestinal complications caused by hip fracture in elderly patients.

sentences.en: The obtained solid base catalyst, which possessed huge specific surface area and good antiacid and waterproof performance, had excellent application prospect.
